escena: SCENE: a real large digital production review wall seen obliquely in a premium creative operations room. Twelve mounted, flat, physical displays form a visible grid STRICTLY BELOW the top 38 percent of the frame, occupying the middle band, each displaying a DIFFERENT useful application of ONE fictional brand world: product hero, social vertical ad, ecommerce card, event invitation, app onboarding frame, email header, web landing, motion end-frame, retail screen, localized campaign crop, sales deck cover and story frame. They share a distinctive cobalt-blue curved geometry and warm ivory material language, with small occasional lime-green touches, yet vary in hierarchy and purpose; NO logos, NO readable words, NO clone tiles. All twelve displays, hands and heads remain below 38 percent of the image height; the upper 38 percent is continuous charcoal acoustic fabric with NO screen edges, faces or highlights. A lead designer in the right foreground selects ONE frame with a hand near the physical display while a second teammate studies a different frame and references a real tablet showing the same system. They are checking differences and consistency, not celebrating a magic one-click system. Warm concrete, anodized blue aluminum rails and actual LED reflections give material depth; no floating UI, no futuristic HUD. 35mm lens, cinematic motivated lateral light, a moment of human judgment in active production. The art wall is the subject; faces are secondary. No paper, sticky notes, charts or counters. THE EXACT MOMENT: the lead designer reaches toward one display to reject its mismatched crop while the teammate checks a different format against the same system. FOREGROUND MUST BE a black dense felt backrest of an empty spectator chair physically almost touching the lens, entirely in unlit shadow; do not illuminate the chair, do not wash it with floor light. It fills the entire bottom 20% as a soft almost-black optical blur, no crisp edge. Keep the LED wall below 38% of image height.

lecho.objeto: the matte black dense felt top of the backrest of the empty spectator chair physically almost touching the lens, entirely UNLIT, far from the warm floor lamp
lecho.tono: DARK NEAR BLACK with faint fabric texture; absolutely no grey flare or wash

texto.muro: a continuous area of charcoal acoustic fabric wall above the entire scene, in deep warm shadow with subtle visible woven texture
